notes.title: Version 1.07 & Halloween Sale
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A quick update today to coincide with the Steam Halloween sale which is due to start this evening. 

Crimson Hotel will be 20% off until November 1st!

Alongside this sale we've got a visual update with a shader change, several lighting improvements and a complete redoing of the post-processing. 

Expect news on the VR update very shortly!

Happy Halloween

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Update 1.05 Live - Japanese language support
notes.content:
Hi all,

Quick (and for us quite exciting) update tonight that adds support for Japanese to Crimson Hotel.

Upon launching the game players with their Steam language set to Japanese should have their game automatically translated, and you can also change your language preference from the options menu.

If there are any languages that you think we should look at including then please comment either here or in the discussions and we'll try our best. 

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Crimson Hotel: VR Testing
notes.content:
[h1]VR Testing now open[/h1]

Hi everyone,

We have added a beta branch featuring virtual reality support and it is now open to all owners of Crimson Hotel. Please note this is highly experimental and as the title says, a test! It will be rough around the edges.

[b]How to access the beta[/b]

You can access the beta by right clicking on Crimson Hotel in your Steam library, choosing [i]PROPERTIES[/i], navigating to the [I]BETAS[/I] tab and choosing [b]vr-testing[/b] from the dropdown.

[b]How do I enter VR mode?[/b]

Once you are on the main menu of the beta build, hit your F1 key. This will launch the VR version.

[b]Controls?[/b]

We're currently using a very basic form of locomotion. Movement is handled exclusively by using your trackpad(s) to move in the direction of your flashlight. Items are collected with your left hand, and doors are opened with either trigger.

[b]Can I play with non-VR friends?[/b]

Yes!

We really, really appreciate the help testing these things and look forward to seeing any feedback about it. Please consider spreading the word to any of your VR friends, relatives, anyone really! We will be setting up a thread in the Discussions for feedback and bug reports.

Thank you!

SI
